in_marathi.name: Chandrani
in_marathi.long_meaning: Chandrani हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Chandrani is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Chandra’ meaning moon and ‘Rani’ meaning queen. The name signifies a queen of the moon, making it a beautiful name for a baby girl in Hindu culture.

in_bengali.name: Chandrani
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Moon Goddess
